input.quote: The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce", "recruit", "employ" and "personnel" return no non-solicitation, no-hire or other restrictive covenant on hiring; the only employment-related language is the independent contractor clause and the indemnity references to employees. The agreement therefore imposes no non-solicit on the Customer, which matches our preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer), so no redline is needed. If Kubient later proposes one, it should be mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the services, capped at 12 months, and carve out general advertising and unsolicited approaches.
